newsitem.title: CANADA: ADM to seek buyer for flour mill - agency.
newsitem.headline: ADM to seek buyer for flour mill - agency.

text.p: An Archer Daniel Midland Co unit will seek to sell one of the Montreal flour mills it has acquired from Maple Leaf Mills Inc, the Canadian government's Competition Bureau said on Friday.

The bureau said Archer Daniel Midland has agreed to seek a buyer for Maple Leaf Mill's Oak Street facility in Montreal. Any transaction would also include certain supply obligations by Archer Daniel Midland to the eventual buyer of the mill, the bureau said.

ADM Agri-Industries Ltd of Toronto acquired wheat flour mills in Calgary, Alberta and Port Colborne, Ontario and two mills in Montreal from Maple Leaf Mills, which is jointly owned by Maple Leaf Foods Inc and ConAgra Inc.
The deal closed on Friday, the bureau said.
Archer Daniel Midland and Maple Leaf Mills are the two largest wheat flour millers in Canada.

The bureau said that if the transaction had been allowed to proceed as structured, "ADM would likely be able to significantly raise prices for hard wheat flour in Quebec/Atlantic Canada, and consumers in these locations would likely pay more for bread and other related bakery products."
